parole.testo: Inherited from Middle French escarmuche, from Old French escharmuche (“skirmish”), from Old Italian scaramuccia (“skirmish”), from Lombardic skirmen or Frankish *skirmijan (“to shelter”). Cognate with Old High German skirmen, scirmen (“to shield, defend, protect”), skirm (“shade, protection”). More

parole.significato: skiff (any of various types of boats small enough for sailing or rowing by one person)
parole.testo: Inherited from Middle French esquif, from Old Italian schifo (“small boat”), from Lombardic skif (“boat”).
